verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַחֹֽקְקִ֖ים אָ֑וֶן חִקְקֵי־ וּֽמְכַתְּבִ֥ים עָמָ֖ל כִּתֵּֽבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ha·ḥō·qə·qîm ’ā·wen ḥiq·qê- ū·mə·ḵat·tə·ḇîm ‘ā·māl kit·tê·ḇū
verses.literal: Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees

verses.original: לְהַטּ֤וֹת דַּלִּ֔ים מִדִּין֙ וְלִגְזֹ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיֵּ֣י עַמִּ֑י לִהְי֤וֹת אַלְמָנוֹת֙ שְׁלָלָ֔ם וְאֶת־ יְתוֹמִ֖ים יָבֹֽזּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haṭ·ṭō·wṯ dal·lîm mid·dîn wə·liḡ·zōl miš·paṭ ‘ă·nî·yê ‘am·mî lih·yō·wṯ ’al·mā·nō·wṯ šə·lā·lām wə·’eṯ- yə·ṯō·w·mîm yā·ḇōz·zū
verses.literal: to deprive the poor of fair treatment and withhold justice from the oppressed of My people to make widows their prey and orphans their plunder

verses.original: וּמַֽה־ תַּעֲשׂוּ֙ לְי֣וֹם פְּקֻדָּ֔ה וּלְשׁוֹאָ֖ה תָּב֑וֹא מִמֶּרְחָ֣ק עַל־ מִי֙ תָּנ֣וּסוּ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה וְאָ֥נָה תַעַזְב֖וּ כְּבוֹדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mah- ta·‘ă·śū lə·yō·wm pə·qud·dāh ū·lə·šō·w·’āh tā·ḇō·w mim·mer·ḥāq ‘al- mî tā·nū·sū lə·‘ez·rāh wə·’ā·nāh ṯa·‘az·ḇū kə·ḇō·wḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: What will you do on the day of reckoning when devastation comes from afar To whom will you flee for help Where will you leave your wealth

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֤י כָרַע֙ תַּ֣חַת אַסִּ֔יר יִפֹּ֑לוּ וְתַ֥חַת הֲרוּגִ֖ים בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ אַפּ֔וֹ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב יָד֥וֹ וְע֖וֹד נְטוּיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bil·tî ḵā·ra‘ ta·ḥaṯ ’as·sîr yip·pō·lū wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ hă·rū·ḡîm bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’ap·pōw lō- šāḇ yā·ḏōw wə·‘ō·wḏ nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Nothing will remain but to crouch among the captives or fall among the slain Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised

verses.original: ה֥וֹי אַשּׁ֖וּר שֵׁ֣בֶט אַפִּ֑י וּמַטֶּה־ ה֥וּא בְיָדָ֖ם זַעְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’aš·šūr šê·ḇeṭ ’ap·pî ū·maṭ·ṭeh- hū ḇə·yā·ḏām za‘·mî
verses.literal: Woe to Assyria the rod of My anger the staff . . . in their hands is My wrath

verses.original: אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ חָנֵף֙ בְּג֤וֹי אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ וְעַל־ עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י לִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֔ז וּלְשִׂימוֹ מִרְמָ֖ס כְּחֹ֥מֶר חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šal·lə·ḥen·nū ḥā·nêp̄ bə·ḡō·w ’ă·ṣaw·wen·nū wə·‘al- ‘am ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî liš·lōl šā·lāl wə·lā·ḇōz baz ū·lə·śī·mō mir·mās kə·ḥō·mer ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will send him against a godless nation I will dispatch him against a people destined for My rage to take spoils and seize plunder and to trample them down . . . like clay in the streets

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ לֹא־ כֵ֣ן יְדַמֶּ֔ה לֹא־ וּלְבָב֖וֹ כֵ֣ן יַחְשֹׁ֑ב כִּ֚י בִּלְבָב֔וֹ לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד וּלְהַכְרִ֥ית לֹ֥א מְעָֽט׃ גּוֹיִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hū lō- ḵên yə·ḏam·meh lō- ū·lə·ḇā·ḇōw ḵên yaḥ·šōḇ kî bil·ḇā·ḇōw lə·haš·mîḏ ū·lə·haḵ·rîṯ lō mə·‘āṭ gō·w·yim
verses.literal: But this is not vvv his intention this is not his plan . . . . . . For [it is] in his heart to destroy and cut off many . . . nations

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א יַחְדָּ֖ו שָׂרַ֛י מְלָכִֽים׃ כִּ֖י יֹאמַ֑ר
verses.transliteration: hă·lō yaḥ·dāw śā·ray mə·lā·ḵîm kî yō·mar
verses.literal: Are not all my commanders kings - he says

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א כַּלְנ֑וֹ אִם־ כְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ לֹ֤א חֲמָ֔ת אִם־ כְאַרְפַּד֙ לֹ֥א שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃ כְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק
verses.transliteration: hă·lō kal·nōw ’im- kə·ḵar·kə·mîš lō ḥă·māṯ ’im- ḵə·’ar·paḏ lō šō·mə·rō·wn ḵə·ḏam·me·śeq
verses.literal: Is not Calno . . . like Carchemish Is not Hamath . . . like Arpad Is not Samaria like Damascus

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ יָדִ֔י מָצְאָ֣ה הָאֱלִ֑יל לְמַמְלְכֹ֖ת וּפְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם מִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּמִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yā·ḏî mā·ṣə·’āh hā·’ĕ·lîl lə·mam·lə·ḵōṯ ū·p̄ə·sî·lê·hem mî·rū·šā·lim ū·miš·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: As my hand seized the idolatrous kingdoms whose images [surpassed] those of Jerusalem and Samaria

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי לְשֹׁמְר֖וֹן וְלֶאֱלִילֶ֑יהָ הֲלֹ֗א כֵּ֛ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְלַעֲצַבֶּֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·šō·mə·rō·wn wə·le·’ĕ·lî·le·hā hă·lō kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lî·rū·šā·lim wə·la·‘ă·ṣab·be·hā
verses.literal: and as I have done to Samaria and its idols will I not also do to Jerusalem and her idols

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־ יְבַצַּ֤ע כָּל־ מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ בְּהַ֥ר צִיּ֖וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶפְקֹ֗ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְעַל־ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת עַל־ פְּרִי־ גֹ֙דֶל֙ לְבַ֣ב ר֥וּם עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’eṯ- yə·ḇaṣ·ṣa‘ kāl- ma·‘ă·śê·hū bə·har ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim ’ep̄·qōḏ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr wə·‘al- tip̄·’e·reṯ ‘al- pə·rî- ḡō·ḏel lə·ḇaḇ rūm ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: - So when the Lord - has completed all His work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem He will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria . . . . . . for the fruit of his arrogant heart and the proud look in his eyes

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר בְּכֹ֤חַ יָדִי֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּבְחָכְמָתִ֖י כִּ֣י נְבֻנ֑וֹתִי וְאָסִ֣יר׀ גְּבוּלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֗ים שׁוֹשֵׂ֔תִי וַעֲתִידֹתֵיהֶם כַּאבִּ֖יר וְאוֹרִ֥יד יוֹשְׁבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·mar bə·ḵō·aḥ yā·ḏî ‘ā·śî·ṯî ū·ḇə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯî kî nə·ḇu·nō·w·ṯî wə·’ā·sîr gə·ḇū·lōṯ ‘am·mîm šō·w·śê·ṯî wa·ʿă·ṯī·ḏō·ṯē·hɛm ka·bîr wə·’ō·w·rîḏ yō·wō·šə·ḇîm
verses.literal: For he says By the strength of my hand I have done [this] and [by my] wisdom for I am clever I have removed the boundaries of nations and plundered their treasures like a mighty one I subdued their rulers

verses.original: יָדִי֙ וַתִּמְצָ֨א כַקֵּ֤ן׀ לְחֵ֣יל הָֽעַמִּ֔ים וְכֶאֱסֹף֙ עֲזֻב֔וֹת בֵּיצִ֣ים אֲנִ֣י אָסָ֑פְתִּי כָּל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְלֹ֤א הָיָה֙ כָּנָ֔ף נֹדֵ֣ד פֶ֖ה וּפֹצֶ֥ה וּמְצַפְצֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏî wat·tim·ṣā ḵaq·qên lə·ḥêl hā·‘am·mîm wə·ḵe·’ĕ·sōp̄ ‘ă·zu·ḇō·wṯ bê·ṣîm ’ă·nî ’ā·sā·p̄ə·tî kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō hā·yāh kā·nāp̄ nō·ḏêḏ p̄eh ū·p̄ō·ṣeh ū·mə·ṣap̄·ṣêp̄
verses.literal: My hand reached as into a nest to seize the wealth of the nations Like one gathering abandoned eggs I gathered all the earth No . . . wing fluttered no beak opened or chirped

verses.original: הַגַּרְזֶ֔ן הֲיִתְפָּאֵר֙ עַ֖ל הַחֹצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ אִם־ הַמַּשּׂוֹר֙ יִתְגַּדֵּ֤ל עַל־ מְנִיפ֔וֹ שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ וְאֶת־ כְּהָנִ֥יף מְרִימָ֔יו מַטֶּ֖ה כְּהָרִ֥ים לֹא־ עֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gar·zen hă·yiṯ·pā·’êr ‘al ha·ḥō·ṣêḇ bōw ’im- ham·maś·śō·wr yiṯ·gad·dêl ‘al- mə·nî·p̄ōw šê·ḇeṭ wə·’eṯ- kə·hā·nîp̄ mə·rî·māw maṭ·ṭeh kə·hā·rîm lō- ‘êṣ
verses.literal: Does an axe raise itself above the one who swings it Does a saw boast over him who saws with it? It would be like a rod - waving the one who lifts it [or] a staff lifting him who is not wood

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יְשַׁלַּ֨ח רָז֑וֹן בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yə·šal·laḥ rā·zō·wn bə·miš·man·nāw wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kə·ḇō·ḏōw yê·qaḏ yə·qōḏ kî·qō·wḏ ’êš
verses.literal: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts will send a wasting disease among [Assyria’s] stout warriors and under his pomp will be kindled a fire like a burning flame

verses.original: אֽוֹר־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְהָיָ֤ה לְאֵ֔שׁ וּקְדוֹשׁ֖וֹ לְלֶהָבָ֑ה אֶחָֽד׃ בְּי֥וֹם וּבָעֲרָ֗ה וְאָֽכְלָ֛ה שִׁית֥וֹ וּשְׁמִיר֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wr- yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·yāh lə·’êš ū·qə·ḏō·wō·šōw lə·le·hā·ḇāh ’e·ḥāḏ bə·yō·wm ū·ḇā·‘ă·rāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh šî·ṯōw ū·šə·mî·rōw
verses.literal: And the Light of Israel will become a fire and its Holy One a flame In a single day it will burn and devour Assyria’s thorns and thistles

verses.original: וּכְב֤וֹד יַעְרוֹ֙ וְכַרְמִלּ֔וֹ מִנֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְעַד־ בָּשָׂ֖ר יְכַלֶּ֑ה וְהָיָ֖ה כִּמְסֹ֥ס נֹסֵֽס׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ ya‘·rōw wə·ḵar·mil·lōw min·ne·p̄eš wə·‘aḏ- bā·śār yə·ḵal·leh wə·hā·yāh kim·sōs nō·sês
verses.literal: The splendor of its forests and orchards both soul and body it will completely destroy . . . as a sickness consumes a man . . .

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֵ֛ץ יַעְר֖וֹ יִֽהְי֑וּ מִסְפָּ֣ר וְנַ֖עַר יִכְתְּבֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ār ‘êṣ ya‘·rōw yih·yū mis·pār wə·na·‘ar yiḵ·tə·ḇêm
verses.literal: The remaining trees of its forests will be so few that a child could count them

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב לֹֽא־ יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד לְהִשָּׁעֵ֖ן עַל־ מַכֵּ֑הוּ בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃ וְנִשְׁעַ֗ן עַל־ יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm šə·’ār yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ə·lê·ṭaṯ bêṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ lō- yō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·hiš·šā·‘ên ‘al- mak·kê·hū be·’ĕ·meṯ wə·niš·‘an ‘al- Yah·weh qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: - On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer . . . depend on him who struck them but they will truly rely on the LORD the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: שְׁאָ֥ר יָשׁ֖וּב שְׁאָ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֶל־ גִּבּֽוֹר׃ אֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: šə·’ār yā·šūḇ šə·’ār ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- gib·bō·wr ’êl
verses.literal: A remnant will return a remnant of Jacob to the Mighty God

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ עַמְּךָ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִהְיֶ֞ה כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּלָּי֥וֹן חָר֖וּץ שׁוֹטֵ֥ף צְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl yih·yeh kə·ḥō·wl hay·yām šə·’ār yā·šūḇ bōw kil·lā·yō·wn ḥā·rūṣ šō·w·ṭêp̄ ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Though . . . your people O Israel be like the sand of the sea only a remnant will return Destruction has been decreed overflowing with righteousness

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת עֹשֶׂ֖ה כָלָ֖ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֑ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·śeh ḵā·lāh wə·ne·ḥĕ·rā·ṣāh bə·qe·reḇ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For the Lord GOD of Hosts will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת אָמַ֞ר עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן אַל־ תִּירָ֥א מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר יַכֶּ֔כָּה בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יִשָּֽׂא־ וּמַטֵּ֥הוּ עָלֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar ‘am·mî yō·šêḇ ṣî·yō·wn ’al- tî·rā mê·’aš·šūr yak·kek·kāh baš·šê·ḇeṭ yiś·śā- ū·maṭ·ṭê·hū ‘ā·le·ḵā miṣ·rā·yim bə·ḏe·reḵ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says O My people who dwell in Zion do not fear Assyria who strikes you with a rod and lifts his staff against you as the Egyptians did

verses.original: כִּי־ ע֖וֹד מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֑ר זַ֔עַם וְכָ֣לָה וְאַפִּ֖י עַל־ תַּבְלִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ miz·‘ār za·‘am wə·ḵā·lāh wə·’ap·pî ‘al- taḇ·lî·ṯām
verses.literal: For in just a little while . . . My fury [against you] will subside and My anger will turn to their destruction

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ וְעוֹרֵ֨ר שׁ֔וֹט עָלָ֜יו כְּמַכַּ֥ת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּצ֣וּר עוֹרֵ֑ב וּנְשָׂא֖וֹ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ וּמַטֵּ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·‘ō·w·rêr šō·wṭ ‘ā·lāw kə·mak·kaṯ miḏ·yān bə·ṣūr ‘ō·w·rêḇ ū·nə·śā·’ōw bə·ḏe·reḵ ū·maṭ·ṭê·hū ‘al- hay·yām miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And the LORD of Hosts will brandish a whip against them as when He struck Midian at the rock of Oreb He will raise . . . His staff over the sea as He did in Egypt

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם סֻבֳּלוֹ֙ יָס֤וּר מֵעַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔ךָ וְעֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֑ךָ עֹ֖ל וְחֻבַּ֥ל מִפְּנֵי־ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm sub·bo·lōw yā·sūr mê·‘al šiḵ·me·ḵā wə·‘ul·lōw mê·‘al ṣaw·wā·re·ḵā ‘ōl wə·ḥub·bal mip·pə·nê- šā·men
verses.literal: - On that day the burden will be lifted from your shoulders and the yoke from your neck The yoke will be broken because your neck will be too large

verses.original: בָּ֥א עַל־ עַיַּ֖ת עָבַ֣ר בְּמִגְר֑וֹן יַפְקִ֥יד כֵּלָֽיו׃ לְמִכְמָ֖שׂ
verses.transliteration: bā ‘al- ‘ay·yaṯ ‘ā·ḇar bə·miḡ·rō·wn yap̄·qîḏ kê·lāw lə·miḵ·māś
verses.literal: [Assyria] has entered . . . Aiath and passed through Migron storing their supplies at Michmash

verses.original: עָֽבְרוּ֙ מַעְבָּרָ֔ה מָל֣וֹן לָ֑נוּ גֶּ֖בַע הָֽרָמָ֔ה חָֽרְדָה֙ גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל נָֽסָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇə·rū ma‘·bā·rāh mā·lō·wn lā·nū ge·ḇa‘ hā·rā·māh ḥā·rə·ḏāh giḇ·‘aṯ šā·’ūl nā·sāh
verses.literal: They have crossed at the ford We will spend the night at Geba Ramah trembles Gibeah of Saul flees

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י קוֹלֵ֖ךְ בַּת־ גַּלִּ֑ים הַקְשִׁ֥יבִי לַ֖יְשָׁה עֲנִיָּ֥ה עֲנָתֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣa·hă·lî qō·w·lêḵ baṯ- gal·lîm haq·šî·ḇî lay·šāh ‘ă·nî·yāh ‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ
verses.literal: Cry aloud . . . O Daughter of Gallim Listen O Laishah O wretched Anathoth

verses.original: מַדְמֵנָ֑ה נָדְדָ֖ה יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַגֵּבִ֖ים הֵעִֽיזוּ׃
verses.transliteration: maḏ·mê·nāh nā·ḏə·ḏāh yō·šə·ḇê hag·gê·ḇîm hê·‘î·zū
verses.literal: Madmenah flees the people of Gebim take refuge

verses.original: ע֥וֹד הַיּ֖וֹם לַֽעֲמֹ֑ד בְּנֹ֣ב יְנֹפֵ֤ף יָדוֹ֙ הַ֣ר בֵּית צִיּ֔וֹן גִּבְעַ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ hay·yō·wm la·‘ă·mōḏ bə·nōḇ yə·nō·p̄êp̄ yā·ḏōw har bēṯ ṣî·yō·wn giḇ·‘aṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Yet today they will halt at Nob shaking a fist at the mount of Daughter Zion at the hill of Jerusalem

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְסָעֵ֥ף פֻּארָ֖ה בְּמַעֲרָצָ֑ה וְרָמֵ֤י הַקּוֹמָה֙ גְּדוּעִ֔ים וְהַגְּבֹהִ֖ים יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mə·sā·‘êp̄ pu·rāh bə·ma·‘ă·rā·ṣāh wə·rā·mê haq·qō·w·māh gə·ḏū·‘îm wə·hag·gə·ḇō·hîm yiš·pā·lū
verses.literal: Behold the Lord GOD of Hosts will lop off the branches with terrifying power The tall trees will be cut down the lofty ones will be felled

verses.original: וְנִקַּ֛ף הַיַּ֖עַר סִֽבְכֵ֥י בַּבַּרְזֶ֑ל וְהַלְּבָנ֖וֹן יִפּֽוֹל׃ס בְּאַדִּ֥יר
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·qap̄ hay·ya·‘ar siḇ·ḵê bab·bar·zel wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn yip·pō·wl bə·’ad·dîr
verses.literal: He will clear the forest thickets with an axe and Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One
